## Problem and result

Describe the user need and the resulting behavior. Link the issue (`Fixes #...` only if fully resolved).

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `git diff --check`

List manual checks and any check not run, with the reason. Include before/after screenshots for visible changes. For relevant changes, check both languages, keyboard navigation and backup compatibility.

## Contribution notes

- [ ] This change preserves URL, storage and import safety boundaries described in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Examples and screenshots contain invented data.

AI assistance, if any: describe briefly. Explain any new dependency or data-format change.
